key_patterns: TealGradientHeader(title, subtitle?, actions?) for hero bars. StatusBadge(status: BadgeStatus) for catch states (ACTIVE/PENDING/FAILED/SOLD). AnchorConfirmedChip for on-chain badges. EmptyState(icon,title,subtitle,actionLabel?,onAction?) for empty lists. ViewModels are @HiltViewModel with StateFlow<UiState>; UiState is a sealed interface (Loading/Success/Error) or data class. Composables obtain VMs via viewModel: XViewModel = hiltViewModel() and receive navigation callbacks as lambdas (onBack, onSellCatch, onNavigateToLoans, ...) — never pass NavController into screens. Navigation wiring lives in NangaNavHost: composable(route){ Screen(onX = { navController.navigate(...) }) }. Rounded corners: MaterialTheme.shapes (medium=8, large=12) or RoundedCornerShape up to 12dp.
